description:
Title: Work and Live in Austria

Please check the requirements for working and living in austria.
Create a process that assists you for a combination of the steps.

Include:
* Organizing accomodation and bank account (negotiation)
* Visa (every x amount of months) - Rot-Weiss-Rot Card  

Requirements  
General principles and requirements for the issue of Visas:  
* visa application form 
* a travel document valid in Austria, with a validity period exceeding the duration of the visa by at least three months and with at least two empty pages, that was issued within the last ten years 
* a passport photo (portrait format, 35 x 45 mm) in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria 
* presentation of an fully comprehensive travel health insurance policy for the planned duration of the stay (amount of cover: 30.000 Euro, valid for the entire Schengen area) 
* proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the duration of the intended stay and for the return journey to the country of origin or residence 
* other evidence requested by the relevant authorities (hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket, proof of gainful employment etc.) - as these are adapted to local standards and coordinated with other Schengen representations, the evidence to be provided may vary depending on location 
* absence of other grounds for refusal (residence prohibition, alert issued by a Schengen country)  

Depending on the circumstances, additional documents may be requested.
Please contact the representation in advance for more information.

Generally speaking, all visa types are issued by representation offices (→ BMEIA) abroad or, in specific exceptional cases, by certain border control posts or, where extension of the visa is permitted, by the state police headquarters.

Schengen visas must be issued by the representation office of the country in which the main travel destination of the visa applicant is located.
If the applicant intends to spend an equal amount of time in several countries (for example, when touring), the competent representation office is that of the country in whose territory the main travel destination is located, on the basis of the length and purpose of the stay.
If it is not possible to determine a main travel destination, the member country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible for issuing the visa.

Territorial competence for applications for category A and C visas falls to the representation office in the consular district where the legal place of residence of the applicant is located.
A representation office may claim exceptional competence for applications from third‑country nationals legally residing but not registered in their district if the applicant can provide justification as to why they had to submit their application to that particular consulate.

Type D visas, however, must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation.
The provisions of Section 8 of the FPG apply to type D visas.
In accordance with these provisions, the territorial competence for carrying out official actions in relation to visas is determined on the basis of the foreign national's the place of residence (i.e. their centre of interest, verifiable by means of e.g. registration forms, residence permit, visa).

A list of all representation offices (addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours, special requirements for issuing visas etc.) can be found on the website of the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_InformationRequest" name="Request for visa information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepresentationInformation" name="Visa information and document requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaDecision" name="Visa decision"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkLiveAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Competent representation or issuing office"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InformationRequest" name="Request information" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_InformationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Information" name="Provide information" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInformation" messageRef="Message_RepresentationInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Submit application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Return visa decision" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Planning" name="Begin planning"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ArrangementsSplit" name="Plan accommodation and bank account"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ArrangementsJoin" name="Accommodation and bank account arrangements planned"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsultOfficeList" name="Consult BMEIA representation office list">
      <bpmn:documentation>Consult the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs website for representation office addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours and special visa requirements.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineCompetentOffice" name="Determine the competent visa office">
      <bpmn:documentation>Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad; in specified exceptional cases they may be issued at certain border control posts or, where extension is permitted, by state police headquarters. Type D visa applications must be made at the competent Austrian representation, with territorial competence based on the applicant's place of residence or centre of interest. For category A and C visas, territorial competence falls to the representation in the consular district of the applicant's legal place of residence. A representation may exceptionally accept an application from a third-country national legally residing but not registered in its district if the applicant justifies applying to that consulate. For a Schengen visa, the responsible country is that of the main travel destination; where time in several countries is equal, determine the main destination based on the length and purpose of the stay. If no main destination can be determined, the country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible. Type D visas are subject to Section 8 of the FPG.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact representation in advance" messageRef="Message_InformationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInformation" name="Receive information and additional document requirements" messageRef="Message_RepresentationInformation"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" name="Are additional documents requested?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" name="Prepare requested additional documents">
      <bpmn:documentation>Depending on the circumstances, additional documents may be requested. Evidence may vary by location and may include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" name="Continue application preparation"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" name="Prepare visa application requirements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteApplicationForm" name="Complete visa application form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check travel document">
      <bpmn:documentation>Ensure the travel document is valid in Austria, was issued within the last ten years, has at least two empty pages, and remains valid for at least three months beyond the duration of the visa.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePhoto" name="Prepare passport photo">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide a portrait-format passport photo, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInsurance" name="Obtain travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned duration of the stay, with cover of 30,000 Euro and validity throughout the Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Prove sufficient means of subsistence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide proof of sufficient means for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check absence of other grounds for refusal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check for other grounds for refusal, including a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" name="Prepare other evidence requested by the authorities">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide other evidence requested by the relevant authorities, accounting for local standards and coordination with other Schengen representations.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" name="Visa application requirements prepared"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application (Rot-Weiss-Rot Card)" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive visa decision" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitForNextInterval" name="Wait until the next visa application interval">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_NextInterval">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P${x}M</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ArrangementsSplit" sourceRef="StartEvent_Planning" targetRef="Gateway_ArrangementsSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrangementsSplit_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrangementsSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_ArrangementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_ArrangementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_ArrangementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_ArrangementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrangementsJoin_OfficeList" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrangementsJoin" targetRef="Task_ConsultOfficeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfficeList_DetermineOffice" sourceRef="Task_ConsultOfficeList" targetRef="Task_DetermineCompetentOffice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineOffice_Contact" sourceRef="Task_DetermineCompetentOffice" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_ReceiveInformation" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveInformation_AdditionalDocuments" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInformation" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocuments_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalDocumentsRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocuments_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareAdditionalDocuments_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocumentsMerge_RequirementsSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_TravelDocument" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_Means" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_RefusalGrounds" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_OtherEvidence" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelDocument_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PreparePhoto" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Means_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefusalGrounds_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherEvidence_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsJoin_Submit" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_ReceiveDecision" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDecision_Wait" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Event_WaitForNextInterval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Contact" sourceRef="Event_WaitForNextInterval" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
